name: Basque Chicken and Peppers (Pollo al Chilindron)
method: braise (sear then braise 35 min in smoked-paprika tomato sauce)
ingredients_verbatim: 2 pounds bone-in skin-on chicken thighs, drumsticks, or both
3 1/2 ounces diced jamon Serrano, pancetta, or bacon (100g)
1 (14.5-ounce) can fire-roasted crushed or diced tomatoes
why: True braise, not skillet/casserole: seared bone-in thighs braised in a smoked-paprika tomato-pepper sauce. Published 452 cal / 6.6g carb per serving sits mid-band and far under the 35g carb ceiling; structurally low-carb (meat + fat + peppers/tomato, no starch base) so it will hold under our own macro recompute. All signature ingredients map to the Omaha board (jamon Serrano substitutes to on-board bacon, which the source itself lists). Scales cleanly to 14 via weigh-and-divide from a braise pot. Not in catalog or accepted-slugs; fills a Basque/Spanish gap the catalog lacks.
